ILLUSTRATIVE PULL REQUEST / NOT SUBMITTED

    Reviewer handoff

    0 of 3 review reminders checked.

    01

    Immediate, not automatic.

    Updates open as they appear, including security updates. No custom schedule or rate limit. Every PR is reviewed.

    02

    A narrow exception.

    Node versions in the frontend POM and CI workflow share one PR so their equality check stays consistent. Otherwise recommended grouping applies.

    03

    One branch to build on.

    Only main is a base. Historic and leftover update branches are not onboarding targets. Renovate manages its own branches.

    THE CONFIGURATION CONTRACT

    Small details.
    Less drift.

    Specification reference, not repository configuration verification.

    Managers and Compose templates

    Root renovate.json extends config:recommended. Include deploy/docker-compose.template and deploy/docker-compose.<feature>.template in scanning, alongside partial applications, container images and CI workflows.

    Node version coordination

    A custom manager tracks node.version in the frontend POM and NODE_VERSION in CI. Update both in one grouped PR. Untagged Paketo builder images require no tracking.

    Release notes and major updates

    Override the source of quay.io/keycloak/keycloak to https://github.com/keycloak/keycloak so changelogs come from actual release notes rather than a release mirror. Major updates get their own PR and the major label.

    Tool ownership and contribution rules

    Dependabot version updates are disabled. The specification calls for deleting stale remote dependabot branches; this page performs no deletion. Follow AI_POLICY.md and the AGENTS sign-off rule where the hosted deployment permits it. Nobody self-operates the hosted Renovate app.

    Local policy demonstration · No packages fetched, branches changed, PRs opened or updates merged.
